$comment: Provenance of each vendored copy. sha is the owning repo's commit the content was read at: for an entry written by .github/workflows/portal-allowlist-vendor.yml that is the dispatching push (the caller's github.sha, on a push that changed docs/portal-allowlist.json); for the initial vendoring (#1380) it was the most recent commit touching that file. scripts/validate-portal-allowlists.py --vendor-check compares the vendored file's CONTENT against this sha and against main nightly in cloudflare-drift.yml, so both definitions check the same thing; the vendor workflow is the only thing that updates an entry.
